collection.name: Google Fonts official pinned repository
collection.license_note: Per-family license text is fetched with the font. Upstream license classification is not a grant for unrelated proprietary fonts.

packs.name: Small project starter
packs.description: 20 families covering interfaces, reading, display, code, Arabic, Devanagari and Thai; inspect real text before choosing.

packs.name: Interfaces and information
packs.description: Sans families with distinct proportions and tone for interfaces, dashboards and product text. Role tags are discovery prompts, not readability certification.

packs.name: Reading and editorial
packs.description: Serif and text families spanning contemporary reading, book typography and expressive headings, including every upstream style in each family.

packs.name: Display and identity
packs.description: Expressive, condensed, rounded, slab, script and experimental families for headings and identity explorations.

packs.name: Code and tabular exploration
packs.description: All currently listed families categorized as Monospace by Google Fonts. Verify required symbols, figure behavior and language support on the exact face.

packs.name: Scripts and multilingual text
packs.description: Families covering Arabic, Hebrew, South and Southeast Asian scripts, Ethiopic, Armenian, Georgian, Japanese, Korean and Chinese. Large CJK families make this pack larger; script coverage remains font-specific.

packs.name: Broad discovery: 300 families
packs.description: A bounded cross-category exploration pack: UI, editorial, display and code selections plus deterministic samples from the remaining listed collection. Selection is not a quality ranking.

packs.name: All currently listed open families
packs.description: Every Google Fonts website family matched to a licensed font directory at this pinned commit. Several gigabytes; use a smaller pack or exact family first.

packs.name: Complete upstream family archive
packs.description: Also includes historical, delisted and experimental family directories present at the pin. This is an archival superset, not a recommendation pack.
